messages:
maria: heads-up — heap of pods in Pending that are GPU-slice sized (0.125-0.25) and not fitting, began ~10:12 UTC. noticed a packing hotspot on us-west pools.

jon: seeing the same. kubectl describe on one Pending pod:```
Events:
  Type     Reason             Age    From               Message
  ----     ------             ----   ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling   2m     default-scheduler  0/8 nodes are available: 8 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
```

maria: problem is fragmentation — nodes have free fractional slots but our device-plugin / scheduler doesn't support fractional allocation across MIG slices well. pods request 0.25 gpu via our fractional device resource.

ryan: CA (cluster-autoscaler) isn't topping up because it thinks there are suitable nodes (they have some free capacity) but fit-probe fails during binpacking check. We get scale-up suppressed.

ali: exact failure pattern: mix of 8-GPU instances (big) + some 1-GPU MIG nodes. Scheduler prefers binpacking which tries to pack into existing big nodes but fragmentation prevents fit. Suggestion: create a dedicated small-gpu nodepool for tiny requests and mark with taint `gpu.size=small:NoSchedule`.

jon: agree. alternative is to change expander strategy to `least-waste` and enable `balance-similar-node-groups`, but that risks cost spike.

maria: cost note — adding small nodes increases per-request cost due to less packing, but avoids preemption waves and long queuing. tradeoff: many tiny pods are latency-sensitive.

sre-bot: ALERT: 1973456789 - gpu-pending-spike - 120 pods Pending > 2m in us-west-prod (auto-generated).

ryan: quick mitigation: 1) temporarily bump cluster-autoscaler flags to allow scale-up for gpu nodegroup (expander=least-waste) 2) create `gpu-small` nodepool (min=0 max=10) with instance type g4dn.xlarge (or single-MIG slice), tainted `gpu.size=small:NoSchedule`, and nodeSelector on the small-slice daemonset.

ali: longer-term: we should support better packing heuristics in our scheduler plugin: expose a packing hint for fractional device plugin and/or adjust QoS so CA accurately simulates fit for fractional GPUs. filing an RFC for device-plugin + scheduler change.

maria: i'll open a PR for quick mitigation to add gpu-small nodepool and update autoscaler expander. tagging @ryan to run cost impact calc.

ryan: will do cost calc and post numbers in infra playbook. initial back-of-envelope: ~$4k/month for 5 small nodes on prod us-west — likely acceptable for steady-state if it avoids 30% latency regressions.

jon: after mitigation, keep `podPriority` for latency-critical slices so they preempt cheaper batch jobs rather than causing binpack failures.

maria: action items: (1) PR for nodepool + autoscaler change (maria) (2) cost calc (ryan) (3) RFC for scheduler/device-plugin (ali). will follow up with runbook link once done. :thumbsup:

ali: +1. posting this to #eng-infra-ops-docs after PR merged. :eyes:
